caption: The drawing depicts a long dress rendered in shades of muted yellowish-brown. The dress features a fitted bodice with gathered fabric across the chest and a decorative detail at the center, just below the collarbone. The neckline is wide and slightly off the shoulder, and the sleeves are very full and puffy at the upper arms, tapering down toward the wrists where they are fitted with cuffs. The skirt of the dress is full and flares outwards from the narrow waist, extending down to the floor. The illustration is presented on a plain, light beige background, and the dress is drawn without any patterns or embellishments, showing only texture and shading to suggest the contours and folds of the fabric. There is no visible head, hands, or lower body parts, as the figure is only a mannequin outline used to display the dress.
title: Dress
